name: Cilia Field
desc: A ciliated epithelium seen across its surface: a carpet of cilia rooted in basal bodies, all beating the asymmetric ciliary stroke -- a fast straight effective sweep then a slow curled recovery -- with neighbours held slightly out of phase so a metachronal wave travels across the whole carpet like wind over a field. The wave vector slowly rotates and a slow drift is mixed in so it never re-phases, while the plane recedes toward a hazed horizon, hairs shrinking and dimming with depth, rooted in a warm mucosal surface. Offered as glowing dark-field, Nomarski DIC relief, tubulin fluorescence, or a sumi ink grass-in-the-wind.

energy.doc: beat amplitude and glow - hairs sweep harder and brighter

scale.doc: magnification - cilia grow longer, guaranteed visible change

speed.doc: beat frequency and how fast the wave vector drifts

density.doc: how densely the cilia pack the carpet

coord.doc: coordination - number of metachronal wave crests across the field

style.doc: aesthetic: glowing dark-field hairs / grey Nomarski DIC relief / tubulin fluorescence on black / sumi ink grass-in-wind

seed.doc: deterministic - re-throws the carpet jitter, hair lengths and phases
